newsitem.title: USA: Greenfield Q3 EPS in range $0.28 to $0.33.
newsitem.headline: Greenfield Q3 EPS in range $0.28 to $0.33.

text.p: Greenfield Industries Inc said on Tuesday it expects to report net sales for the third quarter ending September 30, 1996 in the range of $115 million to $125 million and diluted earnings per share between $0.28 and $0.33.
The company said the earnings will reflect a $3.0 million restructuring charge, or $0.10 a share, fully diluted.

The company reported earnings of $0.50 a share in the year ago third quarter on sales of $104.1 million. First Call's third quarter consensus estimates for Greenfield were estimated to be $0.59 a share.
Greefield said some of its business groups have encountered softness in its business.
Acquisitions are spurring sales growth, but without recent acquisitions the company's third quarter sales would declined by three percent.
The soft market has led to reduced production in certain facilities to match customer demand, temporarily resulting in lower plant efficiencies and higher costs, Greenfield said.
